title: Gallagher Bassett names SA GM as claims model expands
primary_angle: Shelley Reynolds' appointment reinforces GB's focus on customer experience and operational excellence.
rationale: This angle highlights both the leadership transition and the strategic priorities that align with GB's commitment to customer satisfaction and innovation.

posts.angle: Shelley Reynolds joins as GM with a focus on customer experience.
posts.text:
How does leadership impact customer experience in claims management? Shelley Reynolds, General Manager for South Australia, shares her vision for embedding customer feedback into our decision-making. As we expand our claims model interstate, Shelley's leadership will be pivotal in enhancing our service. 

Read more about her appointment in Insurance Business: https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/au/news/breaking-news/gallagher-bassett-names-sa-gm-as-claims-model-expands-586200.aspx

posts.angle: Shelley Reynolds shares her commitment to customer experience as new GM.
posts.text:
I'm excited to step into the role of General Manager for South Australia at Gallagher Bassett. "I’m honoured to take on the permanent role of General Manager for South Australia and continue leading our talented team in supporting employers, injured workers and the broader South Australian community." My focus will be on enhancing customer experience and integrating client feedback into our operations.

Thanks to Insurance Business for sharing this announcement.

https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/au/news/breaking-news/gallagher-bassett-names-sa-gm-as-claims-model-expands-586200.aspx

posts.angle: Shelley Reynolds emphasizes customer experience in her new GM role.
posts.text:
Join us in welcoming Shelley Reynolds as the new General Manager for South Australia at Gallagher Bassett. Her commitment to customer experience and using client feedback will strengthen our operations as we expand our claims-management model interstate. 

Check out the full announcement in Insurance Business: https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/au/news/breaking-news/gallagher-bassett-names-sa-gm-as-claims-model-expands-586200.aspx
